description: This file defines a Catalyst controller for handling error pages, including 400 Bad Request, 403 Forbidden, 404 Not Found, and a conditional 500 Internal Server Error page. It manages error responses and templates for a web application.

classes.name: Coocook::Controller::Error
classes.description: A Catalyst controller class for handling various error responses in the application.

methods.name: bad_request
methods.description: Handles 400 Bad Request errors by setting the response status and rendering an error template.

methods.name: forbidden
methods.description: Handles 403 Forbidden errors by setting the response status and rendering an error template.

methods.name: internal_server_error
methods.description: Handles 500 Internal Server Error page display, conditionally showing a static error page based on a flag.

methods.name: not_found
methods.description: Handles 404 Not Found errors by setting the response status and rendering an error template.
